step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive RC Network (Extracted from Class-E PA)
step1_analysis.description: A passive resistor-capacitor network, likely representing a matching network, filter, or load equivalent circuit from the Class-E power amplifier described in the paper. The active devices (MOSFETs) and inductors are absent from this specific netlist extraction.

paper_reference.title: A Common-Gate Switched 0.9-W Class-E Power Amplifier with 41% PAE in 0.25-m CMOS

gain_900m.description: AC voltage gain at the paper's target operating frequency of 900 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the chosen R and C values. With 50 ohm and 1pF typical values, the network forms a bandpass/highpass filter with attenuation at 900 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Since the active PA components are missing, we measure the passive insertion loss of this network at the RF frequency of interest.

peak_gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the passive network.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the resistive voltage dividers in the passband.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A passive RC network will always have a gain <= 0 dB. The exact value depends on the R1/R3 and R2/R4 ratios.

v_out_max.description: Maximum transient output voltage for a step/pulse input.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 1.8V input pulse, the output will peak based on the capacitive coupling (C2) and resistive division.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adapted for SKY130 1.8V nominal supply instead of the 2.5V used in the original 0.25um paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the AC frequency response and transient step response of the passive RC network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RC Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized component values (assumed typical for RF matching/filtering)
.param R1_val=50 R2_val=50 R3_val=1k R4_val=50
.param C1_val=1p C2_val=1p

* DUT
C1 n1 GND {C1_val}
C2 n0 n2 {C2_val}
R1 n1 label_net_0 {R1_val}
R2 n1 n2 {R2_val}
R3 n1 GND {R3_val}
R4 n0 GND {R4_val}

* Stimulus
Vin label_net_0 GND dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0 1.8 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1M 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(n0)
  
  * Measure gain at 900 MHz (Paper's operating frequency)
  meas ac gain_900m find gain_db at=900M
  
  * Measure peak gain
  meas ac peak_gain max gain_db
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure max output voltage
  meas tran v_out_max max v(n0)
  
  print gain_900m peak_gain v_out_max
  quit
.endc
.end
